## Intent
Marketplace mutations must scope to authenticated `author_id`, and still-public Edge mutating routes must whitelist bodies so clients cannot set privileged fields (`rating`, `downloads`, `author_id`, roles, prices without server authority).

Roadmap: Parent #667 security checklist item 08/08. Acceptance tier: product security fix (not migration isolated-contract).

## Preconditions
- #668 (dispatcher allowlist) CLOSED — unreachable legacy workers stay 404.
- Authenticated user id from JWT / `getAuthenticatedUserId` (never client-claimed author).

## Happy Path
- [x] Marketplace update/delete always constrain `author_id` to authenticated user (adapter + RLS assumed/proven).
- [x] Client cannot set `rating` / `downloads` / `author_id` via update DTO.
- [x] Every still-public Edge mutating route validates/whitelists body fields and rejects unknown privileged keys.
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [x] Update DTO must not allow `author_id`, `rating`, `downloads` from client.
- [x] Delete/update without auth or wrong author → 401/403 / empty RLS deny, never success on foreign rows.
- [x] Unknown privileged keys in Edge POST → 4xx
